insight: Xcode 26 templates enable SWIFT_UPCOMING_FEATURE_MEMBER_IMPORT_VISIBILITY. With it on, `import SwiftUI` alone is not enough for ObservableObject/@Published/Timer.publish — the class fails with "does not conform to protocol ObservableObject" at the USE site, with no error in the class itself. Fix: add an explicit `import Combine`.

Naming a design-token enum `Layout` collides with SwiftUI's own `Layout` protocol (iOS 16+). Errors read as "Type any Layout has no member spineX" and cascade into bogus "cannot find Palette in scope" noise across files. Use `Metrics` or similar.

INFOPLIST_KEY_UIBackgroundModes is silently ignored by GENERATE_INFOPLIST_FILE — xcodebuild -showBuildSettings reports it set, but it never reaches the built Info.plist. Xcode's capability editor writes a real file. Fix: add a physical Info.plist with only UIBackgroundModes and set INFOPLIST_FILE; GENERATE_INFOPLIST_FILE stays YES and merges the rest.

Swift synthesized Decodable does NOT fall back to a property default for a missing key — it throws keyNotFound. Verified by compiling a repro. Optionals survive (decode to nil), which is why earlier schema additions to Wander went unnoticed. Any new NON-optional persisted field needs a hand-written init(from:) using decodeIfPresent, or every store written by a previous build fails to load; OutingStore.load() fails soft, so the symptom is silent total data loss, not a crash.

Seeding a simulator app: (1) editing Library/Preferences/<bundle>.plist directly is ignored — cfprefsd caches it; use `xcrun simctl spawn <sim> defaults write <bundle> <key> <val>`. (2) `simctl terminate` returns before the process dies and the app flushes its own state on the way out, overwriting a freshly written store file; poll `simctl spawn <sim> launchctl list | grep <bundle>` until zero before writing container files. Both produce identical-looking screenshots that waste whole debug cycles.
